raw_segments.text: And so the young man returns into the country of the lotus eaters, and takes up his dwelling
there in the face of all men.
And if any help be sent by his friends to the oligarchical part of him, the aforesaid
vain conceits shut the gate of the king's fastness.
And they will neither allow the embassy itself to enter, nor if private advisers offer the
fatherly counsel of the aged will they listen to them or receive them.
There is a battle and they gain the day, and then modesty, which they call silliness, is
ignominiously thrust into exile by them.
And temperance, which they nickname unmanliness, is trampled in the mire and cast forth.
They persuade men that moderation and orderly expenditure are vulgarity and meanness.
And so, by the help of a rabble of evil appetites, they drive them beyond the border.
